name: Payton Planar Magnetics Ltd.
summary: Payton Planar Magnetics Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and markets planar and conventional transformers worldwide. The company offers transformers; inductors comprising common mode chocks; and off the shelf SMT planar transformers. It serves telecom, automotive, and power electronic markets. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Ness-Ziona, Israel. Payton Planar Magnetics Ltd. is a subsidiary of Payton Industries Ltd.
